expect.finding: user-managed key older than N days (set N=0 for the test)

scenarios.name: Google service agents in bindings
scenarios.stage: GCP-3: the binding phase calls upsertMemberIdentity, so a service agent appears from bindings (not from serviceAccounts.list). Verified live 2026-11-13 (service-829799656183@gcp-sa-pubsub and @gcf-admin-robot appear as gcp_service_agent)

scenarios.name: HMAC key and restricted API key
scenarios.stage: GCP-2 (live check owed: the reader roles for HMAC and API keys are unconfirmed; a missing role shows the surface as not_selected / not_readable, not a blocked scan)

scenarios.name: folder-level binding
scenarios.stage: GCP-3: stored ONCE at the folder (scope_kind account_wide, attrs.attached_to=folders/<FOLDER_A>, attrs.gcp_scope_kind=folder, attrs.ancestors=[org]); there is no stored inherited_from, DEV and PROD inherit it at read time (GCP-6). Fake-tested only: the live project has no organization or folders

expect.cloud_permission: roles/viewer for folder-reader-sa@<SHARED> attached to folders/<FOLDER_A>, inherited by <DEV> and <PROD>

scenarios.name: conditional bindings
scenarios.stage: GCP-3: two rows (native_id carries a condition hash), CEL verbatim in the condition column and attrs.binding_raw, constraint_state=conditional, attrs.expires_at from the request.time bound. Verified live 2026-11-13: both contractor-sa rows, CEL verbatim, expires_at 2027-06-30 and 2026-01-01. The expired-grant FINDING is GCP-8

expect.finding: expired time-limited grant still present (the 2026-01-01 one)

scenarios.name: custom roles
scenarios.stage: GCP-3: custom roles are listed and expanded into the binding's actions (igaOrgAuditor needs an organization, fake-tested only). igaDeployer verified live (expanded, includes iam.serviceAccounts.actAs). A deleted/unknown custom role is kept with attrs.role_unresolved. The actAs FINDING is GCP-8

scenarios.name: public buckets
scenarios.stage: GCP-3 delivers the IAM half (allUsers roles/storage.objectViewer, scope_kind resource, a gcs_bucket cloud_resource). NOT verifiable live yet: Cloud Asset refuses the read-only token scopes, so resource_iam is not_selected (see docs/flows). The ACL half (plane=acl) and the findings are GCP-9 / GCP-8

scenarios.name: binding to deleted SA
scenarios.stage: GCP-3: the binding phase writes the gcp_deleted identity from the deleted: member (a deleted principal is never returned by any list call). Verified live 2026-11-13 (deleted-later-sa is gcp_deleted, bound roles/viewer)

scenarios.name: impersonation
scenarios.stage: GCP-4: project-level Token Creator is ONE gcp_sa_impersonation edge on the gcp_project row with attrs.via_scope=projects/<DEV>; deployer-sa -> app-sa is an edge on app-sa (from sa_iam live). Fake-tested (TestGCP4_TrustEdges); live check owed. The finding is GCP-8

cloud_assume_edge: TEST_USER → every SA in <DEV>, via_scope=projects/<DEV>, role serviceAccountTokenCreator

scenarios.name: GitHub and broad OIDC providers
scenarios.stage: GCP-4: oidc_federation edges, ci_pipeline + issuer token.actions.githubusercontent.com, attrs.attribute_condition; a provider with no condition sets attrs.unconditioned. The iga-github pool is checkable live; the finding is GCP-8

expect.finding: provider gitlab-broad has no (or an always-true) attribute condition
